text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I passed by the dance studio,
Fusaichi Pandora was practicing dance
with a serious expression.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Squeeze tight here, and a turn at the end♪
Phew...
choice_data_list: Your dancing really is amazing, too.
Your dancing really is amazing, too.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? Ahaha☆ Well, yeah,
I can pretty much do anything after all♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, perfect timing.
Say, teach me how to teach dancing, won't ya?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoops... Ugh, I really am
no good at this step...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Kuu-chan-senpai!
I'll teach you the dance♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: W-Whaaat!? Pandora-san!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Or so I said, but honestly,
it didn't work out at all, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I can tell, y'know. Where you're falling short,
or how fixing this part would make it so much better.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Still, I can't really put it into words well, y'know? Like, all I can say is stuff like 'bam!' and 'zap!' for real!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And so, can you help me think of a
good way to make Ku-chan Senpai happy?
choice_data_list: Wait, dumping it all on me!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, you're technically a pro teacher, aren't you?
Please, pretty please~♡"
choice_data_list: I'll set the perfect example with a perfect dance!
Let's set the perfect example with a perfect dance!
I'll tell them as many times as it takes until they understand.
Let's keep telling them until they understand.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, you're technically a pro teacher, aren't you?
Please, pretty please~♡"
choice_data_list: I'll set the perfect example with a perfect dance!
Let's set the perfect example with a perfect dance!
I'll tell them as many times as it takes until they understand.
Let's keep telling them until they understand.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
? So I just gotta show you a dance?
That all?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever! Thanks for now!
I'll give it a shot~♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Finished! H-How is it?
I think I did pretty well, but...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
In... credible~! That was seriously perfect!
You did it, Ku-chan-senpai♡

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank goodness! But I was only able to dance
properly thanks to you, Pandora.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
You gave such a wonderful demonstration that I could really picture the movements.
Thank you so much, Miss Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
K-Kuu-chan Senpai...
Ehehehe, you're welcome♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her genius-level intuition and thoughtful nature, Fusaichi Pandora
had brilliantly rescued her friend from a tight spot.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh, seriously? But if you keep showing someone
how bad you are over and over, won't they hate it?
choice_data_list: If you're serious about teaching, it'll come across.
If you're serious about teaching, they'll understand.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Roger that. In that case,
I'll hit Ku-chan-senpai
with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—Hm-hm-hm-hmmm♪
Then you go whoosh, and then it's like,
Tap, ta-daan!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, right! A turn right at the very end, huh!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, yes!! Peeeeerfect~!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Thanks for watching over me all this time! It's all thanks to you, Pandora-san!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No, no,
it's all 'cause Kuu-chan-senpai did her best♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Good luck in the real race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Fusaichi Pandora's heartfelt coaching,
Rhein Kraft was able to overcome her weakness.
